'''6R-0WL''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] that was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="CWA" /> Like all [[R-series/Legends|R-series]] [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], 6R-0WL built by [[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] and stood 0.96 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="NEGTD" /> 6R-0WL also had a particularly vicious attitude. On [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] during the war, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was offered for sale by the [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] [[80-T5]], who operated a stall in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. 6R-0WL's plating was [[Color/Legends|gray]] and included decals to make it look like a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] at the time he was available for sale.<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|6R-0WL is an astromech with a monstrous attitude!|Store description of 6R-0WL|<ref name="CWA" />}}
6R-0WL first appeared as a purchasable companion for players in the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']] released by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment in [[2010]]. The droid could be bought only during the Life Day event for 300 station cash, a premium in-game currency players have to buy with real money. Given that 6R-0WL's purchase is entirely optional, this article makes no assumptions about if it was bought. The droid's name spells out the word "Growl".
